---
title: "Bray-Curtis Distance by date, site, city"
output:
  pdf_document: default
  html_notebook: default
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyr)
library(rprojroot)
library(vegan)
library(wesanderson)
library(cowplot)
library(ggpubr)
library(rstatix)
library(eoffice)
library(ggdist)  # For raincloud plots

# Set paths and filenames
virome_table <- sprintf("%s/data/wastewater_virome_abundance_table3.tsv", find_rstudio_root_file())
metadata_table <- sprintf("%s/data/wastewater_sample_metadata_table3.tsv", find_rstudio_root_file())

# Load virome table and make it wide
virome_dt <- fread(virome_table, sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
meta_dt <- fread(metadata_table, sep = "\t", header = TRUE)

seqname_sID_wide_dt <- virome_dt %>% 
  select(sequence_name, sample_ID, RPKMF) %>%
  distinct(sequence_name, sample_ID, RPKMF) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sequence_name, values_from = RPKMF, values_fill = 0)

sampleID_l <- seqname_sID_wide_dt$sample_ID
seqname_sID_wide_dt <- seqname_sID_wide_dt %>% select(-sample_ID)

# Calculate Bray-Curtis distance
bray_curtis_dist <- vegdist(seqname_sID_wide_dt, method = "bray")
hist(bray_curtis_dist)

bray_curtis_mat <- as.matrix(bray_curtis_dist)
bray_curtis_df <- as.data.frame(bray_curtis_mat)
colnames(bray_curtis_df) <- sampleID_l
rownames(bray_curtis_df) <- sampleID_l
bray_curtis_df$sampleID1 <- rownames(bray_curtis_df)

melt_long <- melt(setDT(bray_curtis_df), id.vars = c("sampleID1"), variable.name = "sampleID2")

meta_long <- merge(melt_long, meta_dt, by.x = "sampleID1", by.y = "sample_ID", all.x = TRUE, suffixes = c("", ".1"))
meta_long <- merge(meta_long, meta_dt, by.x = "sampleID2", by.y = "sample_ID", all.x = TRUE, suffixes = c(".1", ".2"))

meta_long$Date.1 <- as.Date(meta_long$Date.1, "%Y/%m/%d")
meta_long$Date.2 <- as.Date(meta_long$Date.2, "%Y/%m/%d")

same_site_bray_dt <- meta_long %>% 
  filter(sampleID1 != sampleID2) %>%
  filter(Site.1 == Site.2)

same_site_bray_dt$time_passed <- difftime(same_site_bray_dt$Date.1, same_site_bray_dt$Date.2, units = "days") %>% 
  gsub(" days", "", .)
same_site_bray_dt$time_passed <- as.numeric(same_site_bray_dt$time_passed)

same_site_bray_dt <- same_site_bray_dt %>% 
  filter(time_passed >= 1)

# Plot time passed vs Bray-Curtis within each site
cns_colors <- c("#E64B35", "#4DBBD5", "#00A087", "#3C5488", "#F39B7F", "#8491B4", "#91D1C2", "#DC0000", "#7E6148", "#B09C85")
same_site_bray_dt$City_Site <- str_c(same_site_bray_dt$City, ", ", same_site_bray_dt$Site)

plot1 <- same_site_bray_dt %>%
  mutate(City_Site = str_c(City.1, ", ", Site.1)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time_passed, y = value, color = City_Site)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2, stroke = 0) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE, alpha = 0.8, color = "darkgrey") +
  scale_color_manual(values = cns_colors) +
  facet_wrap(vars(City.1, Site.1)) +
  labs(x = "Days Between Sampling", y = "Bray-Curtis Dissimilarity") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "off")

print(plot1)
ggsave(sprintf("%s/charts/bray-curtis_days_passed_by_site.pdf", find_rstudio_root_file()), plot1, width = 7, height = 6)
# Save plot1 as PPTX
pptx_filename1 <- sprintf("%s/charts/bray-curtis_days_passed_by_site.pptx", find_rstudio_root_file())
topptx(plot1, filename = pptx_filename1, height = 6, width = 7)

# Community distance "same week" for site in same vs different city
all_nonself_bray_dt <- meta_long %>% 
  filter(sampleID1 != sampleID2)

all_nonself_bray_dt$time_passed <- difftime(all_nonself_bray_dt$Date.1, all_nonself_bray_dt$Date.2, units = "days") %>% 
  gsub(" days", "", .) %>% gsub("-", "", .)
all_nonself_bray_dt$time_passed <- as.numeric(all_nonself_bray_dt$time_passed)

same_week_dt <- all_nonself_bray_dt %>%
  filter(time_passed <= 7) %>%
  mutate(site_compare = case_when(
    Site.1 == Site.2 ~ 'Same Site',
    Site.1 != Site.2 & City.1 == City.2 ~ 'Same City',
    City.1 != City.2 ~ 'Different City',
    TRUE ~ 'idk'
  ))

# Plot same week data
pal <- cns_colors[1:3]
stat.test_bray <- same_week_dt %>% 
  wilcox_test(value ~ site_compare, paired = FALSE) %>%
  add_significance(p.col = "p", output.col = "p.signif")

# Create raincloud plot with swapped axes, boxplot on left, cloud on right, and median labels on left
plot2 <- same_week_dt %>%
  mutate(City_Site = str_c(City.1, ", ", Site.1)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(site_compare), y = value, fill = factor(site_compare))) +
  
  # Add boxplot on the left
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA, position = position_nudge(x = 0)) +
  
  # Add median labels on the left side of boxplot
  stat_summary(
    fun = median,
    geom = "text",
    aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", ..y..)),
    hjust = 1.6,   # Position text to the left of boxplot
    vjust = 0.5,   # Center vertically
    size = 3.5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  
  # Add half-violin plot (cloud) on the right with increased distance
  stat_halfeye(
    adjust = 0.5,
    width = 0.6,
    justification = -0.25,  # Position violin to the right with increased distance
    .width = 0,
    point_colour = NA
  ) +
  
  # Add significance comparisons
  stat_compare_means(
    label = "p.format",
    comparisons = list(c("Same Site", "Same City"), c("Same Site", "Different City"), c("Same City", "Different City")),
    tip.length = 0.01,
    hjust = 0.5  # Center significance bars
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
  labs(y = "Bray-Curtis Dissimilarity", x = "") +  # Swapped x and y labels
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "off"
  )

print(plot2)
ggsave(sprintf("%s/charts/bray-curtis_same_week_across_sites.pdf", find_rstudio_root_file()), plot2, width = 4.5, height = 4.5)  # Adjust dimensions
# Save plot2 as PPTX
pptx_filename2 <- sprintf("%s/charts/bray-curtis_same_week_across_sites.pptx", find_rstudio_root_file())
topptx(plot2, filename = pptx_filename2, height = 4.5, width = 4.5)

# Create faceted raincloud plot with swapped axes, boxplot above, and median labels
plot3 <- same_week_dt %>%
  mutate(City_Site = str_c(City.1, ", ", Site.1)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = site_compare, x = value, fill = site_compare)) +
  
  # Add half-violin plot (cloud) above the boxplot
  stat_halfeye(
    adjust = 0.5,
    width = 0.6,
    justification = -0.3,  # Position violin above the boxplot
    .width = 0,
    point_colour = NA
  ) +
  
  # Add boxplot
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA, position = position_nudge(y = 0.15)) +
  
  # Add median labels
  stat_summary(
    fun = median,
    geom = "text",
    aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", ..x..)),
    hjust = -0.3,  # Adjust horizontal position
    vjust = 0.5,   # Center vertically
    size = 3,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
  facet_wrap(vars(City.1, Site.1)) +
  labs(x = "Bray-Curtis Dissimilarity", y = "") +  # Swap x and y labels
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "off",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")  # Adjust facet label size
  )

print(plot3)
ggsave(sprintf("%s/charts/bray-curtis_same_week_facet_sites.pdf", find_rstudio_root_file()), plot3, width = 10, height = 8)  # Adjust dimensions
# Save plot3 as PPTX
pptx_filename3 <- sprintf("%s/charts/bray-curtis_same_week_facet_sites.pptx", find_rstudio_root_file())
topptx(plot3, filename = pptx_filename3, height = 8, width = 10)
```
